newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Air Force cargo plane crashes, two dead.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Air Force cargo plane crashes, two dead.

text.p: Two people were killed and six injured when an Argentine Air Force Boeing 707 cargo plane crashed at Buenos Aires' main international airport on Wednesday, the state-run Telam news agency reported.

The aircraft, flying in from Chile, was forced to make an emergency landing and crashed 200 yards (meters) from the runway at about 2.30 p.m. (1730 GMT), an Air Force official told a local television station.
Television footage showed the jet lying in grass at Ezeiza airport with its rear half severed.
The plane was carrying a cargo of 25 tons of fish, Telam said. Further details were not immediately available.
